s.t:
Build relationships with group tour operators, make sales calls, and arrange for familiarization tours of USNA. Increase group sales and reach or exceed USNA attendance targets. Evaluate and analyze visitation from group tour operators. Identify opportunities to increase business from previous and existing clients.

Contact tour operators to bring in new and increased business. Identify group tour operators who have not visited USNA and develop a relationship with those operators to encourage visitation. Establish and maintain a customer relationship management database to track touchpoints with group sale leads and customers.

Coordinate with the Scheduling Coordinator to schedule and confirm group bookings. Advocate for group tour operators internally. Solicit group feedback and present suggestions and plans on how to improve the group tour experience. Book familiarization tours of USNA.

Greet tour operators upon arrival and make sure the participants are provided guided tours of the Yard focused on the group tour experience.

Generating group ticket sales revenue through a high volume of proactive, outbound sales outreach, including phone calls, emails, texts, etc Prospecting for new leads and new sales opportunities Maximizing group ticket sales opportunities from existing and inbound leads Conducting in-person and virtual sales appointments Assist with creation of collateral material.

Write copy for group tour profile sheets, website pages, and other group tour promotional materials. Ensure that all marketing materials are persuasive, easy to understand, and within brand guidelines Provide group tour marketing materials to the local Destination Marketing Organizations (DMO). Cultivate relationships with travel and tourism partners, with a focus on tour operators and related associations. Projection formulation for annual revenue and budget annually. Work with Tour Guide Manager, visitors and partners to develop new product. Reporting & Data Analysis - Collects, organizes, and analyzes productivity and performance data to support office operations and management decision-making.

Maintains and updates Point of Sale (POS) and inventory information; prepares and distributes accurate daily sales reports. Tracks discrepancies and resolutions submitted by staff members. Compiles and consolidates data for management reports, ensuring clarity and consistency in reporting.

Supports inventory accuracy through regular product reconciliation tasks. Prepares quarterly reports on commission events, including documentation and verification of proof of payment and internal records and compliance.

Record Keeping - Maintains physical and digital records, maintains the department bulletin board, handles confidential and sensitive information, submits personnel and medical documentation to Human Resources, ensures proper procedures are followed to protect HIPPA and PII. Provides exceptional customer service to patrons, Midshipmen, USNA faculty and staff, and vendors in person, over the phone, and via email. Organizes office supplies, processes vendor invoices, processes and maintains accounts payable and receivable invoices for Tours Group Sales, and Timekeeping.

May be called upon to assist with retail, cashier, and other duties, and for Midshipmen (mission) support events when needed. Attends off-site meetings and trade shows as needed. Gestalte mit uns datengetriebene B2B Sales und GTM Strukturen
Du möchtest im Vertrieb nicht nur bestehende Leads bearbeiten, sondern moderne Go to Market Systeme aktiv mitentwickeln? In dieser Rolle verbindest du Business Development mit datenbasiertem Prospecting, AI Tools, automatisierten Workflows und strukturierten Outbound Prozessen.
Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du skalierbare Prozesse für ein modernes B2B SaaS Umfeld. Du recherchierst und qualifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, analysierst Märkte und Ansprechpartner, arbeitest mit CRM und Sales Tools und entwickelst personalisierte Outreach Sequenzen über verschiedene Kanäle.
Neben der operativen Ansprache potenzieller Kunden führst du kurze Discovery Calls, dokumentierst relevante Daten sauber im CRM und unterstützt dabei, Lead Scoring, Datenanreicherung, Automatisierungen und Übergaben an den weiteren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Du passt zu uns, wenn du Vertrieb als Zusammenspiel aus Kommunikation, analytischem Denken, Prozessverständnis und Technologie begreifst und Lust hast, moderne Sales Infrastrukturen aktiv mit aufzubauen.
Aufgaben

s.h: Auf diese spannenden Aufgaben darfst du dich freuen
s.t:
Business Development & Outbound Sales: Du recherchierst und identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen, erstellst strukturierte und datenbasierte Prospecting-Listen und sprichst potenzielle Kunden gezielt über E-Mail, LinkedIn und Telefon an. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Director entwickelst du daraus eine belastbare und skalierbare Sales Pipeline.
Opportunity Development & Qualification: Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls, analysierst Anforderungen, Use Cases und Entscheidungsstrukturen und qualifizierst Opportunities anhand klarer Kriterien für die nächsten Schritte im Sales-Prozess.
AI-gestütztes Prospecting: Du kombinierst moderne Research-Methoden, Datenquellen, Buying Signals und AI-basierte Personalisierung, um passende Zielkunden effizient zu identifizieren, relevante Ansprechpartner zu priorisieren und qualifizierte Gespräche vorzubereiten.
Outreach & Messaging: Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Outreach-Sequenzen und optimierst Messaging, Targeting, Personalisierung und Kanalwahl kontinuierlich auf Basis von Kampagnen-, Engagement- und Performance-Daten.
CRM & Pipeline-Steuerung: Du strukturierst und pflegst HubSpot zuverlässig, dokumentierst Aktivitäten, Kontakte und Opportunities transparent und schaffst damit die Grundlage für eine datenbasierte Steuerung von Outreach, Forecast und Deal-Fortschritten.
Automationen & Go-to-Market-Prozesse: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Clay-Workflows und verbindest HubSpot, Clay sowie weitere Outreach-, Daten- und GTM-Tools zu effizienten Prospecting- und Automatisierungsprozessen.
Testing & Optimierung: Du konzipierst und testest neue Kampagnen, Sequenzen und Workflows, wertest die Ergebnisse systematisch aus und optimierst Prozesse auf Basis relevanter Kennzahlen, um Effizienz, Datenqualität und Conversion Rates nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Qualifikation

Erfahrung im modernen Business Development: Du bringst 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Business Development, SDR Umfeld oder B2B Sales mit. Strukturierte Zielkundenrecherche, Prospecting, Outreach sowie Erstgespräche und Discovery Calls gehören für dich zum Vertriebsalltag.
Sicherheit im modernen GTM Stack: Du hast bereits mit modernen Sales, CRM und GTM Tools gearbeitet, insbesondere mit HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator sowie Plattformen wie Lemlist, Apollo oder vergleichbaren Lösungen. Idealerweise kennst du auch datenbasierte Workflows zur Recherche, Anreicherung und Priorisierung von Leads.
Kommunikation mit Relevanz: Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und zielgruppengerecht, schriftlich wie mündlich. Du verstehst, wie personalisierte Ansprache, relevante Trigger und überzeugendes Messaging im modernen Outbound zusammenspielen.
Struktur, Ownership und Lernbereitschaft: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Gleichzeitig bist du bereit, dich schnell in neue Tools, Datenquellen, Prozesse und technologische GTM Ansätze einzuarbeiten.
Technologie und AI Affinität: Du interessierst dich für moderne Prospecting und Go to Market Prozesse und verstehst den Mehrwert von AI gestütztem Research, automatisierter Datenanreicherung, Personalisierung und datenbasiertem Outbound. Erste Erfahrungen mit Clay, Workflow Automationen oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Kenntnisse aus SaaS oder Startup Umfeldern sind ein Plus.
Wichtig für uns: Du musst kein fertiger GTM oder Automatisierungsprofi sein. Entscheidend ist, dass du moderne Outbound Prozesse verstehst, gerne mit Kunden sprichst, strukturiert mit Daten und Tools arbeitest und Lust hast, Sales, Technologie und skalierbare GTM Prozesse miteinander zu verbinden.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Sales Director: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Director zusammen und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in Vertriebsstrategie, Go to Market, Pipeline Aufbau und skalierbares Wachstum.
Flexibles Arbeiten: Ob remote oder hybrid, wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, das konzentriertes Arbeiten, digitale Zusammenarbeit und Flexibilität sinnvoll miteinander verbindet.

Gestaltungsfreiraum statt starrer Prozesse: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, entwickelst Prospecting, Outreach und GTM Prozesse aktiv weiter und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Sales Infrastruktur und Revenue Engine langfristig aufgebaut werden.
Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für eigene Themen, Kampagnen und Prozesse. Wir vertrauen auf Eigeninitiative, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und schnelle Umsetzung.
Moderner GTM und AI Stack: Du arbeitest mit modernen Sales, Daten und Automatisierungstools wie HubSpot, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lemlist, Apollo sowie weiteren Lösungen für Research, Datenanreicherung, Prospecting und Outreach.
Performanceorientierte Kultur: Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, datenbasiert und mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Ergebnisse. Gute Ideen, Ownership, saubere Prozesse und kontinuierliche Optimierung zählen bei uns mehr als Hierarchien oder Titel.
Direkte Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungswege: Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, transparent und mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen. Entscheidungen werden schnell getroffen, neue Ansätze zügig getestet und Ergebnisse direkt in die weitere Optimierung überführt.
Noch wichtig: Auch wenn du bei uns vollständig remote arbeitest, muss sich dein dauerhafter Arbeitsort in Deutschland befinden. Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist in dieser Position nicht möglich.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenLabs is building its first dedicated Canadian go-to-market team, and this is a founding Enterprise Account Executive role based in Canada. We’re looking for an experienced, motivated seller to drive ElevenLabs’ growth in Fortune 500 and large-scale enterprises across Canada.

Working alongside the team led by our GM of Canada, you’ll help build our Canadian enterprise playbook from the ground up.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology, and eager to act as a strategic partner - enabling organizations to leverage our industry-leading models and product to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.
In this role you will
Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals
Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency
Generate and own pipeline through targeted outbound into priority accounts, partnering with SDRs and our partnerships team to break into the C-suite
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends
Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more
Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs’ presence within key Canadian enterprise verticals (e.g., financial services, public sector, telecom).
Partner closely with customer success and solutions engineering to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion of accounts.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating them on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.
Proven success closing seven-figure deals and managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
Proven ability to self-source pipeline and build territory from scratch in a new or greenfield market.
Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes, with ability to accelerate deal velocity.
Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.
Strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.
Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity, plus the competitive, ownership-driven mindset to thrive in an early-stage, high-growth environment and build new playbooks, processes, and territory from scratch.
Passion for Agentic AI / Voice AI / Audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.
A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale
Bilingual (English/French) is a plus
Location
This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere in Canada, with a strong preference for candidates based in Toronto. You’ll operate primarily in the ET timezone, with the ability to collaborate across CT, MT, and PT as needed. If you’re not based near one of our hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend so you can work from a space that suits you.

THE JOB Warum mute-labs? Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.
Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.

Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR , der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.
Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.
Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur . Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.
09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.
The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.
The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia , um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO , in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
Erkennst Du Dich wieder? Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.
Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.
Full-Cycle Mindset: Du magst sowohl den Reiz, neue Leads zu finden, als auch das gute Gefühl, einen Deal selbst zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Team Player: Arbeiten in Silos ist nichts für Dich. Du möchtest Erfolge teilen, voneinander lernen und Deine Kolleg:innen genauso bei ihren Deals unterstützen wie bei Deinen eigenen.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen? Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!

Location: Remote — Mexico
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Influencer Marketing / Marketing Technology / Advertising
Compensation: $1,000 – $2,000 USD/month base + uncapped variable compensation (OTE approximately 50/50)
Experience: 2+ years
Languages: Native Spanish + Professional English
Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.
Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics . The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.
Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.
This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion .
You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

Build & Own Your Pipeline
Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG .
Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.
Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.
Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.
Run Full-Cycle Sales
Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.
Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.
Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.
Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.
Build an AI-Native Sales Process
Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.
Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.
Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.
Build the Commercial Playbook
Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.
Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.
Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.
Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.
Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business .
Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.
Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers .
Native Spanish.
Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.
Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel , including follow-up and deal progression.
Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms .
Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands .
Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.
Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.
Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.
This Role Is NOT for You If...
You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.
You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.
You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.
You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.
You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.
Candidate Evaluation Considerations
During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:
Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.
Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.
Full-cycle closing experience.
Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.
Consultative selling and negotiation skills.
Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.
Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.
Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.
What Success Looks Like
You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.
You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.
Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.
New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.
Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.
Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.
Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.
Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy .
Build processes rather than simply inherit them.
Fully remote work across Latin America.
Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.
Occasional travel for important brand meetings.
Important Notes
This is a highly hands-on individual contributor sales role .
Candidates must have personally prospected for new business within the last year.
Candidates should be prepared to discuss previous quota performance and sales results with specific numbers.
Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate how they currently use AI and automation in their sales workflow .

Are you an enterprise sales professional who treats business development as a craft, not just a numbers game? Do you want to move past transactional, inbound-dependent selling to open major accounts from scratch, taking full ownership of the sales narrative for an early-stage product where technical credibility and strategic context matter?
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Enterprise software sales requires deep technical curiosity and real ownership, especially when introducing a completely new product category. AppGlass is our new AI-powered production debugging product designed to help engineering teams investigate complex issues directly within running applications. Because this is an early-stage product, we are building our enterprise pipeline from the ground up, moving past inherited inbound funnels to establish direct relationships with engineering leaders.
In this role, you will lead the full outbound enterprise sales execution for AppGlass across Europe. You will work independently to self-source opportunities, map complex organization structures, and gain access to senior technical decision-makers.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Lead to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), funnel strategy, and product messaging based on real-world interactions.

You will own the entire commercial relationship – from initial discovery through security, procurement, and contract execution – directly influencing how our product scales in the global enterprise market.

Identify and reach relevant engineering decision-makers within target enterprise accounts.
Source your own sales pipeline through professional networking, targeted outreach, referrals, and industry events.
Lead comprehensive discovery sessions and commercial conversations with technical champions and economic buyers.
Drive enterprise pilot programs forward, ensuring clear alignment between user feedback and commercial goals.
Navigate complex security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement cycles, and vendor onboarding processes.
Negotiate and finalize B2B commercial agreements to secure new enterprise customers.
Deliver structured feedback from prospects to product teams to help continuously refine positioning and features.

A problem-solving mindset that enjoys turning early-stage product complexity into clear, structured business value.
The autonomy to drive enterprise deals independently and take full accountability for the revenue outcomes.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical engineering concepts intelligently with developers and financial realities with executives.
A commitment to building long-term trust with clients over securing quick, transactional wins.
Resilience and adaptability when navigating the ambiguous, evolving landscape of a new product launch.
What you’ll need
A proven track record of closing enterprise B2B sales for highly technical products, such as developer tools, observability, infrastructure, cloud, or security software.
The demonstrated capability to open major enterprise accounts from zero without relying on pre-existing inbound leads.
An established professional network among engineering leaders and senior technology executives.
Hands-on experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal frameworks, compliance hurdles, and information security evaluations.
Strong command of strategic outbound pipeline generation methodologies.
Fluency in written and spoken English for daily collaboration across international teams and client organizations.
What success looks like
Success means establishing predictable, scalable enterprise sales for AppGlass. You will earn the trust of the team by consistently securing qualified meetings with enterprise decision-makers and turning raw outreach into active, progressing pilot programs. You win when you navigate complex security and procurement hurdles smoothly, converting early-stage pilots into stable, long-term paid commercial agreements that validate our market positioning and drive sustainable revenue growth.

This role calls for a strong hunter mindset and passion for working in a hyper-growth MarTech scale-up with a rapid sales cycle. Good news: our differentiated product is already in high demand! We have a world-class sales organization with a strong pipeline bombarded with inbound marketing leads and SDR lead generation.

We’ve got clients from every vertical imaginable, and our client base speaks for itself. You will get supported by Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, and Sales Enablement functions.

Minimum 4 years of quota-carrying sales experience, preferably in SaaS.
Knowledge of market research, sales, and negotiating principles.
Proven oral and written communication abilities, effective phone skills, and exquisite listening skills.

Ability to succeed working cross-functionally with direct sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
Superior project and time management skills.
The ability and flexibility to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
We are on the hunt for an Account Executive, focused on P&C Insurance to join our team and expand our rapidly growing list of clients. SafeLease has launched a property and casualty product that has been built from the ground up and tailored for self-storage.

There are over 50,000 self-storage facilities in the United States and skyrocketing insurance premiums have become a major pain point in the industry. SafeLease ’s P&C product aims to help facility owners solve that pain with the most customizable product available.
We have big aspirations for this business segment and are looking for entrepreneurial team members who share the same level of ambition.
